name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
title: Clean Science and Technology Ltd - 543318 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 8% QoQ to INR193 cr on volume-led recovery, but FY26 standalone fell 12% to ~INR796 cr; MEHQ pricing under China pressure and new capacity still ramping (PC-1 utilisation ~10-15%).

utilisation.quote: March was almost around 40%, Arun. Stand-alone March quarter.

capex.quote: The change in plant commercialization timeline is attributed to scarce manpower resources as labor movement is observed due to increase in gas prices.

triggers.label: Standalone revenue +8% QoQ, volume-led
triggers.quote: the revenues improved by 8% to INR193 crores, largely due to increase in customer offtake

triggers.label: HALS exit utilisation ~40% in March
triggers.quote: March was almost around 40%, Arun. Stand-alone March quarter.

triggers.label: Long-term contracts block phenol pass-through
triggers.quote: wherever there has been long -term contracts, in those cases, we have not been able to pass.

triggers.label: Chinese HQ diverted into MEHQ; new entrants
triggers.quote: There could be some competition within China, and we are well placed to compete with them.

triggers.label: Performance Chem 2 commercial slip to Sept-26
triggers.quote: we expect to commercialize by September '26

guidance.quote: Yes, absolutely. We are aspiring to do that.
It could be in the range of max INR80 crores to INR100 crores.
we expect to commercialize by September '26

red_flags.label: FY26 standalone revenue down 12%; customer loss
red_flags.quote: This is attributed to loss of key account or a particular customer in an FMCG, which is 4-MAP product

red_flags.label: Chinese-sourced phenol/acetone arbitrage dependence
red_flags.quote: we bought majority of phenol and acetone from China, which was never the case in last many years.

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on volumes, product numbers
red_flags.quote: We don't give all these product by product math, Arun, you are aware of it.

evasions.quote: We don't give all these product by product math, Arun, you are aware of it.
we have taken a conscious call not to share that level details.
This is going to be a very tricky financial year for chemical industry in my view.

evasions.topic: HALS FY27 target and HQ catechol utilisation
evasions.quote: we don't want to pencil in any price hikes and give guidance as this is a very evolving situation as of now.
